messages:
Maya (Design): posted a focused mock for the autoscale/capacity panel — includes min/max inputs, burst toggle, GPU pool picker, and an SLO slider. figma: https://figma.com/file/unique123
Alex (Product): nice. main ask: make the SLO slider inviting. add a "Balanced (100 ms)" preset and tiny helper text explaining tradeoffs.
Samir (Eng): FYI pools are g4, l4, a100. dropdown should show estimated qps and $/hr. backend can return those metrics.
Maya (Design): plan: two-line dropdown rows: name + small text like "~600 qps · $2.80/hr". keeps things compact.
Leah (Accessibility): a11y nits: 1) slider must support arrow keys (1% step) and PageUp/PageDown (10%). 2) secondary copy contrast needs to be >=4.5:1. 3) pool dropdown needs typeahead and aria-activedescendant.
Samir (Eng): guardrail: if user selects SLO <60 ms on l4, show inline note: "Estimated p95 ~120 ms with this pool." API will compute estimate.
Maya (Design): draft guardrail copy: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst." ok tone?
Leah (Accessibility): prefer neutral wording and mark the message with role="status" so screen readers announce it immediately.
Jon (SRE): burst tooltip suggestion: "Burst allocates spare GPU slots for short traffic spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." also require telemetry: capacity.burst.triggered {team_id, pool, duration_s}.
Samir (Eng): will emit that event on successful allocation. also backend will offer /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest for recommended min/max.
Maya (Design): on recommended ranges: UI will show "Recommended: min 2 — max 8" with a one-click Apply. default min/max fallback is 1/16.
Alex (Product): add confirmation if new min > current instances: buttons "Apply and migrate (may restart)" vs "Apply without migration".
Leah (Accessibility): modal must trap focus and have clear aria-labels. ensure form controls use proper aria-labelledby.
Maya (Design): i'll update figma with contrast, keyboard notes, ARIA hints, revised guardrail copy, burst tooltip, and recommended range UI. will post link when ready.
ops-bot: uploaded updated figma: https://figma.com/file/unique123?node-id=21 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): acceptance criteria: 1) accessible SLO slider + labeled presets; 2) pool list shows qps & $/hr + typeahead; 3) burst toggle w/ tooltip & billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply.
Samir (Eng): ETA: 2 sprints. will coordinate APIs.
Maya (Design): thanks everyone — updating specs now and will share final mock tomorrow. :sparkles:
